business_scope.primary_industry_name: Computerized Embroidery and Ultrasonic Seaming of Custom Plush Dolls

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – Common Law foundation supplemented by residual French civil law and customary law influences
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: None applicable – no active comprehensive bilateral investment treaty, double taxation agreement, or free trade agreement is currently in force for Vanuatu; taxation exemption is conferred unilaterally by the International Companies Act [Cap 222].

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (as amended, including the beneficial ownership obligations introduced by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018); Anti-Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2020 (Act No. 21 of 2020); Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2018; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 265]; Beneficial Ownership (International Companies) Regulations 2018; Corporate Service Providers Act 2017; and applicable FIU directives issued by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and External Trade; Hague Apostille does not apply because Vanuatu is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and External Trade

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence using FATF-aligned principles: all directors, shareholders, signatories and natural-person UBOs are screened against the United Nations Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU/UK sanctions lists, and Vanuatu domestic regulatory warnings. PEPs are subjected to enhanced due diligence, including source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring. The 25% beneficial ownership threshold is mandatory and cannot be diluted by tiers, trusts or corporate intermediaries.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission E-Registry / VFSC Online Name Reservation Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All company names must be expressed in the Latin alphabet (English, French, or Bislama script). Non-Latin script trade names, including Chinese, must be accompanied by a mandatory Latin-script transliteration or vernacular name. The name must be distinguishable from existing registered names and must not be misleading, offensive, or contrary to public policy. Acceptable statutory suffixes include 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Société Anonyme' or 'SA'.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: registration or licensing is required for any name implying financial services, regulated activities, or official government sponsorship
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within the applicable appeal period (normally not less than 14 calendar days) after the Registrar issues a name rejection, the applicant must submit a written administrative appeal to the Registrar of International Companies at the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission through the VFSC E-Registry. The appeal must include the original name-search certificate, a copy of the rejection notice, the desired name and a permissible alternative name, and any ministerial consent or regulator licensing approval needed for sensitive tokens. The Registrar shall render a decision in writing within a reasonable statutory or administrative window; if the appeal is unsuccessful, the applicant may pursue judicial review before the Vanuatu Supreme Court.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a standalone statutory address. An International Company must maintain a registered office in Vanuatu, supplied by a licensed registered agent under the Corporate Service Providers Act 2017 and the Registered Agents and Trustees Licensing Act [Cap 266]. A virtual office may serve only as an ancillary or correspondence address and cannot satisfy the statutory registered-office or commercial-substance requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low but non-negligible, estimated at under 5% annual probability for a low-risk plush-mascot OEM International Company with Swift/TT and Platform-Pay payment rails. The VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit retain statutory powers to conduct unannounced physical inspection if any indicator of nominee abuse, undeclared UBOs, sanctions exposure, or inadequate substance is identified.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap. 222, ss. 6–13 (incorporation, memorandum, directors, registered office, share capital) and s. 53 (annual maintenance)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry, Registration and Supervision Division
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of an International Company (Form IC-01) together with the Application for Incorporation of an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required; no escrow account is mandated. The initial issued capital may be USD 1,000 or its equivalent divided into shares of no par value, and at least one share must be subscribed and issued to the founding shareholder.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation of Vanuatu International Company VU_IC under the International Companies Act, Cap. 222 be and is hereby approved, with an authorized share capital of USD 1,000 divided into ordinary shares of no par value, fully subscribed by the founding shareholder; that the first registered office of the Company shall be situated at the office of the licensed registered agent, Port Vila, Vanuatu; that [names of two natural persons] be and are appointed as first directors; that the directors are authorized to open bank accounts, appoint officers, maintain statutory registers, and do all acts required to complete registration and begin lawful operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Registered Agent Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – International Companies Registry via the VFSC e-Registry portal or a licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three descending priority name choices with a brief statement of proposed activities; receive a name clearance certificate or a statutory reservation of the approved name for 30 days. Concurrently appoint a class-A registered agent licensed by the VFSC and obtain the agent's written consent.
required_dossiers: Identity and passport copies of the ultimate beneficial owner and proposed directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is refused, substitute a cleared alternative and file a new reservation; the registry fee is credited toward the final application if filed within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized Vanuatu notary public and the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association, share subscription forms, share register, and consent forms. Execute the documents before a notary public; verify all signatures and share subscription details; have the licensed registered agent countersign to certify statutory compliance with the International Companies Act, Cap. 222.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or registered agent raises formal defects such as unsworn signatures or inconsistent share clauses, amend and re-execute the offending pages; no additional government fee is charged if resubmitted within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission to VFSC and Incorporation Examination
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – International Companies Registry, Registration and Supervision Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete incorporation application with the prescribed government fee of USD 250.00 and the registered agent's declaration. The Registrar will review the name, statutory clauses, and director consents; upon approval, the VFSC will issue the Certificate of Incorporation and an extract of the register of members.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the Registry issues a written notice of defect within seven days. Cure the specified defect by filing an amendment; failure to cure within 90 days may result in abandonment with a pro rata refund of fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Corporate Governance and Registrar Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry and the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass a written resolution to adopt the registered office, appoint officers, approve share certificates, and confirm the registered agent's office as the statutory address. File the registered office notice, first director list, and share register extract with the Registry; obtain a Certificate of Good Standing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is rejected for missing director information, resubmit with sworn declarations; late-filing penalties are waived if the corrected filing is made within 14 days of the original filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial Premises, Business Licence, and Operational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority / Department of Industry, together with the municipal business licensing office and Vanuatu Fire Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a manufacturing business licence for the physical factory dedicated to plush manufacture, computerized embroidery, and ultrasonic seaming. Verify zoning compliance of the premises; submit the lease or occupancy certificate, floor plan, fire safety equipment list, and workers' compensation insurance proof. Obtain an environmental screening registration if not exempt and secure the municipal operational permit.
required_dossiers: Certificate of occupancy or lease agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the municipality requires a change of permitted use, apply for a zoning variance or relocate to a designated industrial area; a business licence appeal may be lodged with the Ministry of Trade, Commerce and Industry within 21 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) together with the Department of Industry of the Ministry of Trade, Commerce and Industry
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Manufacturing Business Licence (Plush Doll and Mascot Production)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Environment Protection Agency (EPA) – Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – Registration/Screening; no full Environmental Impact Assessment required for non-hazardous garment and plush assembly operations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial wastewater discharge: pH 6–9, BOD ≤ 30 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L; no free cyanide or chlorinated solvents. VOC emissions from ultrasonic bonding and adhesives, if used, shall not exceed 500 mg/Nm³ at process stacks; fabric dust and fiber particulates limited to 10 mg/m³ in workplace air. Solid waste including fabric offcuts and polyester fiber must be stored in covered receptacles and removed by a licensed waste hauler within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from Vanuatu Fire Service (annual inspection and certificate), structural load inspection certificate from municipal building control, and an occupational health and safety registration from the Department of Labour confirming emergency exits, machine guarding, ventilation, and worker hygiene protocols.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR); official portal: https://dcir.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities incorporating a Vanuatu International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] do not obtain a tax identification number from DCIR because ICs are statutorily tax-exempt. Registration with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) is required for incorporation, which issues a company registration number. If the IC voluntarily registers for VAT or becomes liable for VAT through local taxable activities, it must apply to DCIR using Form VAT-01, providing the certificate of incorporation, foreign/domestic address details, and director identity documents. For purely offshore operations, no TIN is issued; an Exemption Certificate is available on request.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Vanuatu law. The International Company is categorically tax-exempt. Voluntary VAT registration election is available under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 248] where the IC elects to make local taxable supplies. There are no hybrid mismatch elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 3,000,000 (three million vatu) annual taxable turnover; compulsory registration triggers at that threshold, voluntary registration permitted below threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping system is currently mandated. VAT-registered persons must issue prescribed tax invoices and file returns via DCIR electronic system (VITARA); no API-based real-time clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods physically exported from Vanuatu within the prescribed period, provided the supplier retains documentary evidence of export and the goods are not later returned. Export of plush mascot stuffed animals qualifies if title passes to a non-resident and the goods are shipped abroad. Offshore services must meet the exported-services test, such as services directly connected with exported goods or performed and supplied for use wholly outside Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration or Single Administrative Document approved by Vanuatu Customs
Bill of Lading or airway bill evidencing physical export from Vanuatu
Evidence of transfer of possession to the international carrier
Inward Remittance Certificate/foreign bank SWIFT credit evidencing payment by non-resident buyer
Copy of the zero-rated VAT invoice
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DCIR may launch audits and retrospective reviews of zero-rating claims. If substantiation is inadequate, VAT is clawed back with interest from the filing date. Fraud penalties may include fines up to VUV 5,000,000 and imprisonment up to 3 years; further civil penalties include up to 150% of evaded tax and cancellation of VAT registration for repeat non-compliance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125]; sole monetary authority, issuer of the Vatu (VUV), and statutory administrator of exchange controls pursuant to the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 128]. Corporate registry and non-bank AML/CFT supervision are administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates an open, de facto fully convertible regime: both current-account (trade, services, income remittance) and capital-account (direct equity, loans, liquidation proceeds) flows are free from quantitative restrictions, with no prior approval or licensing requirement for non-resident International Companies. The VUV is independently floated without an official peg, and profit remittance by ICs is legally unrestricted. Practical hurdles arise from VUV's shallow offshore liquidity and global correspondent-bank de-risking: banks require an RBV Exchange Control form, board-resolved dividend or withdrawal minutes, beneficial ownership attestation, and tax-clearance confirmation for every outward remittance, with standard processing delays of one to three business days.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender obligation, mandatory conversion ratio, or prescribed repatriation timeline exists in Vanuatu. An IC exporting plush mascot goods under HS 9503 may retain 100% of USD export proceeds in a Foreign Currency Account at a domestic bank or offshore without conversion into VUV. However, proceeds from physical shipments must be credited through the domestic banking system and matched to customs export declarations, bills of lading or airway bills, and commercial invoices; unsupported or purely offshore pass-through invoicing will be treated as an AML/CFT red flag and may result in account suspension.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD and VUV current accounts) with segregated Capital Escrow Account and Foreign Currency Account (FCA) overlay
Operational Account and FCBU Foreign Currency Account (USD, AUD, VUV)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Low-Medium. Vanuatu has no statutory fintech EMI or e-money licence track; deposit-taking from within Vanuatu requires a bank licence under the Financial Institutions Act or the International Banking Act. Leading global EMIs (Wise, PayPal, Stripe, Revolut) do not onboard Vanuatu-incorporated ICs for multi-currency settlement due to correspondent-bank de-risking, the absence of SEPA/FPS connectivity, and VUV's unfunded status; Platform_Pay collections must therefore be structured as marketplace payouts settled into a USD FCA via SWIFT rather than as local digital accounts. A legally viable alternative is a licence under the International Banking Act for a dedicated treasury vehicle, supplemented by a small domestic VUV account at BSP or NBV for statutory costs.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is the practical norm: BSP and NBV require at least one director or board-authorized signatory to attend an in-person KYC interview at a Port Vila or Luganville branch. Fully remote video onboarding is possible only at bank discretion for established corporate-group referrals and is not guaranteed for newly incorporated non-resident ICs. The IC's licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] must co-sign the account introduction form, and the bank will independently verify the agent's standing with the VFSC before accepting any digital-only KYC package.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore IC with no demonstrable Vanuatu nexus and no economic substance, registered purely for tax exemption
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, registered office agreement, VFSC registered-agent appointment letter, economic-substance declaration evidencing management oversight from Vanuatu, lease or co-working service agreement for the registered office, and a 12-month operational budget.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ambiguous source of funds for the initial equity capital injection into the IC
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Passport and proof of identity of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO), six months of source-account bank statements for the remitter, audited or certified financial statements of the founding entity, notarized board resolution resolving the share subscription and account opening, and a sworn declaration of source of wealth and source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-mismatch red flags: material outbound USD wires to Asian OEM suppliers without matching inbound receipts or shipping evidence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Factory purchase orders and RFQs, pro-forma invoices, commercial invoices and packing lists, bills of lading or airway bills, VU customs export and import declarations, letter-of-credit drafts, warehouse inventory records, and a quarterly rolling cash-flow and receivables forecast signed by the treasurer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity is routed via SWIFT MT103 through recognized correspondent corridors (Sydney, Hong Kong, Singapore, or New York USD-clearing) into the IC's USD-denominated FCA or operational account. The wire mandate must specify the economic purpose code 'Direct Investment - Equity Capital (Share Subscription)' and must be matched by an RBV Exchange Control Form EX filed at the receiving bank before credit is finalized. Verification of the VFSC-registered allotment, the board resolution authorizing the share issue, and the remitter's bank statements confirming the source of funds is mandatory; vague purpose codes such as 'general settlement' will trigger a three-to-five-business-day compliance hold.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For OEM raw materials (fabric, PP cotton, polyester beads, ultrasonic spare parts) and finished-goods logistics, outbound settlements should use: (i) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for amounts below the bank's value-date threshold (typically USD 50,000-100,000) citing 'Import Payment - Goods'; (ii) irrevocable commercial Letters of Credit at sight or 30/60-day usance governed by ICC UCP 600 for bulk orders above USD 100,000, with documents conforming to invoice, packing-list, and inspection-certificate requirements; and (iii) Platform_Pay payouts (Wise or embedded marketplace rails) only for low-value refunds and B2C marketplace disbursements, settled onward into the USD FCA. VUV is not accepted by overseas suppliers; accordingly, the IC should maintain 100% of trade disbursement balances in USD, holding VUV solely for local registered-agent, government, and VFSC statutory fees.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable foreign exchange forward contracts (USD/VUV) offered by BSP and NBV treasury desks, permitted only with documented underlying commercial trade exposure.
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV against USD via international market-makers, typically 3-6 month tenors, extendable to 12 months with bank credit support.

Cross-currency swaps (USD/VUV) at facility level, permitted where matched to approved financing inflows and evidenced to RBV Exchange Control, available only through treasury-dominated corporate banking desks.
European-style FX options (call/put structures on USD/VUV) for hedging uncertain platform-revenue conversion volumes.
Natural in-kind hedging through 100% USD pricing of trade payables and receivables with zero VUV balance-sheet exposure, which remains the dominant market practice for Vanuatu IC trading entities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (prescribed form under Section 90, International Companies Act [Cap 222]) confirming company name, registration number, registered office, registered agent, directors, members, share capital, charges, and beneficial ownership details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Port Vila
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month after each anniversary of incorporation; the filing window is anniversary-based, not calendar-year-based (e.g., incorporated 15 March, due by 14 April annually)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of approximately USD 100 (VT 10,000) plus incremental monthly surcharges; continued default beyond six months after the anniversary triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution under Part VI of the Act; restoration requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and a restoration fee of USD 500 or more

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee (annual license/maintenance fee payable concurrently with the Annual Return to preserve legal existence and tax-exempt status)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same anniversary-based window: on or before the last day of the one-month grace period following each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment on the due date triggers a reinstatement surcharge of 10-50% of the annual fee plus late penalties; non-payment for 12 months results in automatic strike-off without further notice; assets of a struck-off company may vest in the Republic of Vanuatu

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for any Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], regardless of revenue, assets, or employee count; an audit arises only if the company's articles mandate it, shareholders pass an audit resolution, or an external lender, investor, or OEM buyer contractually requires a certified audit
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory accounting framework applies to International Companies; voluntary financial statements may be prepared under IFRS or US GAAP; accounts are not filed with VFSC and are not matters of public record

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Annual Return must confirm the current beneficial owners as at the anniversary date; on any transfer of shares in the plush-toy holding IC, the Register of Members must be updated and the new beneficial ownership details filed with VFSC within 14 days after transfer approval; VFSC maintains a central beneficial ownership register accessible to domestic and foreign competent authorities
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (share ledger recording issued shares and all transfers)
Register of Directors (names, residential addresses, appointment and resignation dates)
Register of Charges (mortgages and encumbrances over company assets)
Minute Book (board and shareholder minutes and written resolutions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 - 500 per annum (VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila, inclusive of registered office services and custody of statutory registers)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable/not required by statute; voluntary certified audit by a Vanuatu-accredited CPA firm for a small plush-mascot trading IC typically USD 2,500 - 5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, and no withholding tax at the national level. International Companies (ICs) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] are statutorily exempt from every present and future tax, duty, rate, or levy on income, profits, assets, dividends, interest, royalties, and capital by operation of Section 109 of that Act.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory zero-rate regime for ICs: (1) zero corporate income tax on trading profits from the global manufacture and export of plush mascots and stuffed toys; (2) zero dividend, interest, and royalty withholding tax on profit repatriation; (3) zero capital gains tax on disposals of shares; (4) zero stamp duty on IC share transfers; and (5) exemption from Vanuatu business license fees for out-of-jurisdiction trading. Non-income charges may nonetheless arise if local substance is added: 1% Payroll Tax (Payroll Tax Act 2008) on wages of Vanuatu citizen or permanent-resident employees, 12.5% Value Added Tax on domestic taxable supplies above the registration threshold, and employer (4%) and employee (2%) Vanuatu National Provident Fund contributions on the insurable wages of local staff.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return / Annual Declaration of Compliance — prescribed VFSC form filed with the Registrar of International Companies through the licensed IC agent; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation; the gazetted annual government fee must accompany the filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered IC name, VFSC company registration number, date of incorporation, and registered office address in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Approved by the licensed local IC agent on behalf of non-resident shareholders; beneficial owner details are maintained on the agent's AML file, not publicly filed, but must be disclosed to the VFSC on demand under the AML/CFT Act 2021.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that during the preceding year the IC has not conducted business with any person resident in Vanuatu, has not offered securities to the public in Vanuatu, is not licensed under any Vanuatu sectoral law, and continues to satisfy the International Companies Act requirements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This attestation is the operative condition of the Section 109 tax exemption. A false 'no business with residents' declaration in respect of local warehouse or e-commerce sales to Vanuatu customers is a criminal false-declaration risk and exposes the IC to income tax, VAT, and penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part C — Agent, Directors, and Register Maintenance
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current licensed agent details, directors' names and addresses, share structure, and confirmation that statutory registers are maintained at the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors need not be Vanuatu residents; a single natural-person director may be a nominee, but the nominee must acknowledge fiduciary duties in writing. VFSC scrutiny targets nominee shell misuse where beneficial ownership is concealed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: a 100% surcharge on the unpaid annual government fee plus any VFSC administrative late fee; continued non-renewal triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution under the International Companies Act, automatic loss of IC status, and a restoration surcharge before reinstatement is accepted. No income tax return penalty attaches because Vanuatu does not assess income tax on ICs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Payroll Tax Return — Payroll Tax Act 2008; lodged with the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC) using the prescribed payroll tax return, in paper or through the VRC electronic filing channel.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the end of each calendar quarter (31 March; 30 June; 30 September; 31 December).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Employer tax identification number, legal entity name, physical trading address, and contact details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Required only if the IC employs at least one Vanuatu citizen or permanent resident. An IC managed wholly offshore with no local payroll need not file but must retain payroll records to prove the absence of local employment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total wages, salaries, allowances, and other payments subject to payroll tax; tax at 1%; less exempt payments; net payroll tax payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident or expatriate employees are excluded from the 1% local payroll tax to the extent they are not Vanuatu citizens or permanent residents, but statutory deemed monthly taxable wages may apply where such employees are physically present in Vanuatu; amounts are payable quarterly with the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of Vanuatu National Provident Fund (VNPF) contributions: employer 4% and employee 2% of insurable wages for all employees under the VNPF age threshold.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: VRC and VNPF data are cross-matched; under-declaring payroll heads to avoid payroll tax while remitting VNPF contributions is treated as deliberate evasion.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment penalty of 1% per month on unpaid payroll tax, an additional 25% penalty for failure to notify chargeability, default assessment where no return is filed, and criminal liability for evading payroll tax punishable by fine and imprisonment for responsible officers. The VRC may impose a 100% surcharge on deliberately unpaid or concealed payroll tax.
